title: The penguin palette
hints: To choose colours yourself, use a manual scale: `scale_colour_manual(values = ...)`.
The values are used in the order of the species levels: Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo.
The legend title can be set with `labs(colour = "Species")` or the scale's `name` argument.
